newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Keppel Telecom in rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Keppel Telecom in rights issue.

text.p: Keppel Telecommunications and Transportation Ltd (Keppel T&T) said on Monday it planned to raise up to Singapore $123.9 million in a rights issue and warrants.
Keppel Telecom said in a statement it would issue up to 112.7 million new ordinary shares of S$0.20 at S$1.10 each, with up to 56.3 million warrants expiring in 2002.
It said the proceeds from the rights issue would be used to further the Keppel T&T group's investments in shipping, telecommunications and logistics services.
The proposed rights issue would be offered on the basis of two rights shares for every four existing ordinary shares, the statement said.
